entries.name: Somja
entries.content:
Somjanians are people from a race of people who posses red colored eyes. They are originaly from Rocklands, more north.
Somjanian are known for their cruelty and blood magic rituals. They are often ambicious and ruthless people.
Somjanians have good connection towards war and combat.
There are now very few of them.
Somjanians live mostly in Commonlands now.
Somja is a goddess they pray to, she gives them strenght and passion.
Somjanians are often more passionate and agressive, although it always depends on invidual.
Somja religion is a religion with members consisting mainly of Somjanians. Somjanians can convert other people to their religion. The process of converting people into Somja's followers is simple: 1) Having sex with at least two Somjanians. After this happens, the invidual will be given blessing of the goddess Somja.
Somja gets her powers from how many people follow her.
People converted into Somja religion just get additional power and strength, but their lives are now tied to their goddess Somja. They also get one physical mutation, their eyes become red.

entries.name: Commonlands
entries.content:
Commonlands are very plain, often being perfect place for humans for their easy to live in conditions.
Their neighboring lands are Rocklands - north, Swamplands - south west, Anthrolands - north east, Darklands - south east. Commonlands are in middle of the Great Continent, the only continent in this dark fantasy world.
Commonlands are generally peaceful and safe.
They are mostly flat lands of grass and rivers. There is lot of forest too.
Commonlands are mostly occupied by humans, however other creatures can be found here like dwarfs, elfs, goblins, anthros. Other creatures are more rare, but not impossible to find.
In middle of Commonlands lies The Capital, the symbol of The Great Human Kindgom.
